title: GS1 Sector Codelist
description: The GS1 Sector code list (NACE-style Section A–U), published as its own resource because it changes far less often than the domain manifest and may be reused by other GS1 tooling. Publish at registry/sectors.jsonld. The SPA fetches this at runtime as the source of truth for sector navigation; adding, renaming or reordering a sector requires no SPA code change or redeploy, only an update here.

codeName.description: Human-readable section label, e.g. 'Section H – Transportation and storage'.
